introduction.purpose: This document specifies the requirements for the klklk web application, a task management tool designed for the general public. It serves as a formal agreement between stakeholders and the development team.
introduction.document_conventions: Requirements are written in clear, testable language using 'The system shall...' format. Priority levels are High, Medium, Low.
intended_audience_and_reading_suggestion: Developers: Focus on system features and external interfaces.
Project Managers: Review overall description and nonfunctional requirements.
Testers: Use functional requirements for test case creation.

product_scope.summary: The klklk application allows users to create, manage, and organize personal tasks through a web interface, with user authentication and data persistence.
goals: Deliver the primary klklk user workflow through a web application.
Support scalable growth with modular MERN microservices.
business_objectives: Reduce manual effort in the primary business process.

references: IEEE Std 830-1998, IEEE Recommended Practice for Software Requirements Specifications.

product_perspective.system_context: klklk is a standalone web application that interacts with a MongoDB database and provides a React-based user interface, built with Node.js and Express microservices.

product_functions: Creation, reading, updating, and deletion of todo items.
Organization of todos with categories or tags.
Marking todos as complete or incomplete.

user_classes_and_characteristics.characteristics: Individuals needing to manage personal tasks, with basic web literacy.

overall_description.operating_environment: The application will operate in modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and server environments supporting Node.js and MongoDB.
design_and_implementation_constraints: Use of MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).
Microservices architecture with defined service ports.
Response time must be under 2 seconds for all operations.
user_documentation: Online help guide accessible within the application.
FAQ section for common user queries.
overall_description.assumptions_and_dependencies: Assumes users have a valid email address for authentication. Depends on MongoDB for data storage and Node.js runtime environment.

user_interfaces.description: Responsive React-based UI with forms for task management and authentication.

software_interfaces.description: NoSQL database for storing user accounts and todo items.

communications_interfaces.description: Communication between frontend and backend microservices via RESTful endpoints.

performance_requirements: The system shall respond to user actions within 2 seconds under normal load conditions.
security_requirements: User passwords shall be hashed and salted before storage.
The system shall enforce authentication for accessing user-specific data.
software_quality_attributes: Maintainability: Code shall be modular and well-documented.
Usability: The interface shall be intuitive for general users.
business_rules: Each user must have a unique email address.
Todos are private to the user who created them.

database_requirements: Use MongoDB with collections for users and todos.
Ensure database indexes are optimized for query performance.
legal_requirements: Comply with general data protection principles for user data storage.

additional_requirements.description: The delivered solution shall include deployment, API, and operational support documentation.

endpoints.description: Register a new user with email and password.
Authenticate a user and return a session token.
Retrieve all todos for the authenticated user.
Create a new todo for the authenticated user.

glossary.definition: A task or item that a user needs to complete, stored with a title and status.
An individual with a registered account in the system.

annotation_guidelines: Each requirement should be atomic and testable.
